description: Launching a token on a SUI bonding curve takes three transactions, each signed and executed before the next: step `publish` (name, symbol, description, iconUrl), then `register` (publishDigest), then `create` (publishDigest, devBuy SUI, feeMode 0 Creator / 1 Buyback & Burn / 2 Holders / 3 Balanced, website, x, telegram). Launch fee 1 SUI plus gas.

devBuy.description: SUI for the creator's first buy (optional).

publishDigest.description: Digest of the executed publish transaction.

sender.description: A Sui address, 0x and 64 hex digits.

name: build_launch_step
title: Build a token launch step (unsigned)
